protocol.window: last 2 s (200 policy steps) of the episodes that did not terminate

protocol.pwm: per-tick (300 Hz) first difference over alive ticks, all motors pooled; the first tick of each episode excluded
protocol.action: executed policy_action (100 Hz), squared norm of the change, steps t >= 2
protocol.env: eval env (long VIO buffer, motor_pwm traced): bitwise the training env

protocol.override: one DR field set to the value in every episode, the rest the full-DR draw; thrust spread rescales the drawn per-motor deviation to the half-width
protocol.act_delay: ticks of extra action latency; 3k + r runs as k whole policy steps (DelayEnv) plus r ticks in the graph FIFO

protocol.wind: horizontal speed set in the drawn direction, the drawn vertical kept
protocol.drop: in-distribution success minus effect success on the same episodes

protocol.paired: vs the same policy on its training estimator (e1), same episodes

protocol.observations: obs the policy acted on in e9's eval-env episodes at (1,1), alive steps of the recorded episodes, first N
protocol.latency: single-sample perf_counter_ns per call on this machine, 1-min load average 23.03 at the start, 18.23 at the end

protocol.a: held-out episode 0, 300 ticks, 1 drone on Cranelift vs the JAX env (env.step with the training-path float32 forward); also vs the env stepped with the in-graph float64 forward
protocol.b: held-out episodes 0..255, 1500 ticks each, one 1-drone Cranelift world per episode vs the JAX env; labels from the trajectories by the env's tests; max |dpos| over the steps until the JAX episode ends
protocol.c: held-out episodes 0..15 as 16 drones in one Cranelift world, 1500 ticks, vs 16 vmapped env episodes; the same world on jax-cpu as a cross-check
protocol.bench: bench.py --world: elodin's profiler, median 3-tick batch after a warm-up batch
bench.worker: DroneEnv mekf6, 1024 envs x 32 steps scan, 8 XLA host devices, random actions, median of 5
protocol.training_loop: median per-iteration steps_per_s of train.py (rollout + PPO update) from each run's log.jsonl
protocol.suite: this run's own deterministic eval rollouts, compile included
protocol.note: 1-min load average 1.28 at the start, 1.24 at the end; training-loop figures are from the training runs and their conditions
